description: Path-length test, run directly on the tip so a positive result is immediately bankable. Deviation from the H10.2.1 text: it uses the E090 base instead of E086, so it reuses the seeds 3-26 E090 baseline from the H4.2.7 run and needs no new control. Base: E090 code. In the 32 px phase only (the final 2.75 epochs at bs 1024, floor-hold included), multiply the conv-filter Muon lr schedule by 1.25 (0.24 -> 0.30 at the same schedule position). The head keeps its 0.5x multiplier and scales along. The 16/24/28 px phases are unchanged. Implement it as a phase-keyed host-side factor written into the existing 0-d lr tensor, so nothing recompiles. Decide on off-seed seeds 3-26, paired against the E090 baseline, plus two distinct scored samples.
